placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Uphill offers a quieter starting point for exploring the coast near Weston-super-Mare. The beach, village and nearby hillside create a varied setting for a family walk without needing to travel far between stops.

Choose a short beach-side outing or consult the council's Uphill walks guide for a longer route. Our family idea: compare the view towards Brean Down with the view back along Weston Bay and sketch the outline of the hills.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Families who want sea views and a flexible-length walk.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Village services are nearby; bring what you need for your chosen route.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Follow local signs for parking near Links Road and check beach-parking conditions before arrival.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Stay away from tidal mud and observe beach notices. Longer routes can include slopes and uneven paths; check the route before bringing a buggy.
